create_got_ocr2_config: create a GotOcr2Config with custom vision and text settings for OCR model initialization
build_got_ocr2_model: build a GotOcr2Model that encodes images and processes text with multimodal fusion
run_got_ocr2_generation: run GotOcr2ForConditionalGeneration to generate OCR text output from input images and prompts

configure_got_ocr2_vision: configure GotOcr2VisionConfig with custom attention, embedding, and MLP parameters for the vision encoder
